clips.text: Tonight, your heart hands you its job — 100,000 beats a day, all yours.
A moment ago, his heart was racing — up the stairs, before an exam. Now it waits for orders.
But some people already slow their hearts down. Free divers drop theirs to twenty beats a minute.
The trick is cold water on the face. Splash it on, hold still — and feel your pulse slow.
Cold water, a slow breath out — and your pulse answers.
Your heart only beats when you tell it to — so who keeps it beating while you sleep?
Your heart has its own tiny brain — and it never asked your permission. Tap the link under my name.
